description: Normative fact-export-v1 schema for the tool_calls table. Captures preference-agnostic tool execution facts (D1, F2), keyed input fingerprints for loop detection (I08), and replaceable outcome statuses as late tool results arrive.

call_id_hmac.description: Session-qualified 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 of the harness tool_use_id / call_id when observed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff call_id_status == 'observed'; null iff call_id_status == 'not_reported'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Pairs PreToolUse/tool_use with late PostToolUse/tool_result without cross-session collisions (F8, D1).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether call_id_hmac is non-null.
x_justification.why_present: Eliminates null ambiguity on tool call identifiers.

canonical_harness.description: Closed canonical harness vocabulary, including unknown.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed enum.
x_justification.why_present: Supports per-harness tool capability funnel (I06) and failure loop analysis (I08).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether duration_us is non-null ('observed') or null ('single_point_only' when awaiting result or only one boundary was captured, 'not_observable' when timestamps are absent).
x_justification.why_present: Prevents missing duration from being confused with a 0-microsecond tool execution.

duration_us.description: Tool execution duration in microseconds when both start and end boundaries are observed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff duration_status == 'observed'; null otherwise (never 0 for unknown duration).
x_justification.why_present: Measures tool execution latency when paired start/end events are available (D1).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether input_fingerprint_hmac is non-null.
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes tool calls with hashed input fingerprints from records where tool input was absent.

input_fingerprint_hmac.description: Keyed 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 fingerprint of the tool input (privacy::tool_fingerprint) when available.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff fingerprint_status == 'observed'; null iff fingerprint_status == 'input_unavailable'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Enables identical-input retry and failure loop detection (I08) without persisting raw arguments or file paths.
x_justification.zero_content: 64-char hex HMAC digest; raw command/arguments are never stored (DE-004).

invocation_key.description: Foreign key to invocations.invocation_key when the parent model invocation turn is linked.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff invocation_link_status == 'linked'; null when the tool event came from an unassociated hook or lacked a parent turn.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Links tool executions back to the model invocation turn that requested them.

invocation_link_status.description: Explicit status explaining whether invocation_key is linked or why it is absent.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether invocation_key is non-null.
x_justification.why_present: Eliminates null ambiguity on invocation_key.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether occurred_at_us is non-null.
x_justification.why_present: Eliminates null ambiguity on tool execution timestamps.

occurred_at_us.description: Tool execution timestamp in UTC microseconds since Unix epoch when observed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff occurred_at_status == 'observed'; null iff occurred_at_status == 'not_observable'.
x_justification.why_present: Used for 600-second window failure-loop detection (I08) and timeline ordering.

outcome_status.description: Tool execution outcome status. Replaceable within a generation as late tool_result events arrive (D1).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Replaces nullable boolean 'failed' with an explicit 5-state vocabulary; 'pending' and 'unknown' require a non-null outcome_unknown_reason.
x_justification.why_present: Drives tool failure rates and I08 failure loops, and supports within-generation outcome replacement (D1, EN3c).
x_justification.zero_content: Closed enum literal; never stdout, stderr, or exception text (DE-004, F5).

outcome_unknown_reason.description: Explicit reason code when outcome_status is 'pending' or 'unknown'; null when 'succeeded', 'failed', or 'cancelled'.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff outcome_status is 'pending' or 'unknown'; null otherwise.
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes in-flight tool calls awaiting a late result from permanently unrecorded tool results.

pseudonym_key_id.description: Identifier of the customer-held HMAC key used to pseudonymize entity keys in this row.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-empty key identifier.
x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Tracks key lineage for tool_call_key, call_id_hmac, and input_fingerprint_hmac.

sequence_no.description: Zero-based or positive source sequence order within the session generation.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-negative integer.
x_justification.why_present: Preserves exact consecutive tool ordering required by I08 tool loop detection.

session_key.description: Foreign key to sessions.session_key (64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required foreign key on every row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Associates tool calls with their session for replacement and session-level rollups.

signal_source.description: Observation surface that produced the tool call record.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed enum.
x_justification.why_present: Identifies whether the tool call was observed via session logs, hooks, or native OTLP.

source_generation.description: Monotonic ingestion generation number for source_id.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required positive integer (>= 1).
x_justification.why_present: Scopes replacement of tool call rows when late results arrive within a generation.

source_id.description: Pseudonymized 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 identifier of the ingestion source.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required on every row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Binds the tool call to its ingestion source for replacement and coverage accounting.
x_justification.zero_content: Hex HMAC digest; never a file path (DE-004).

structured_write.description: True if the tool performs a structured file/code modification (e.g. Write, Edit, apply_patch).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required boolean matching tool_facts.structured_write.
x_justification.why_present: Identifies code-mutating sessions for engineering activity and outcome proxy analysis.

tool_archetype.description: Preference-agnostic Behavioral Execution Archetype per AGENTS.md §1 Invariant 5 and DE-005.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Uses 'unknown' when archetype cannot be classified; never null.
x_justification.why_present: Aligns AOB and dendro on a single preference-agnostic behavioral tool taxonomy.

tool_call_key.description: Primary key: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym of the tool call observation.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required primary key on every row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Uniquely identifies the tool call row across replacement snapshots.

tool_category.description: Closed operational tool category from dendro_core::facts::ToolCategory (DATA_DICTIONARY.md §3.2).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed 8-value enum; defaults to 'other' when unclassified.
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes engineering work (build/test, code edit, VCS, read) from coordination ceremony.

tool_name.description: Closed built-in vocabulary or mcp_hmac_<64hex>; custom names are keyed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-empty safe identifier token.
x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Resolves F2 (Codex real tool names in shared scan) and feeds I06 capability funnel.
x_justification.zero_content: Strict identifier token without whitespace, slashes, or arguments (DE-004).
